messages:
Alex: Heads-up — post-launch backlog spike after the canary. Need to decide: do a short hotfix sprint for the worst regressions or absorb into next iteration? Quick poll + proposal below.

Maya: Can we list the top customer-facing regressions from telemetry? I pulled signals this morning:
- latency spike on streaming endpoints
- truncated chat responses for long sessions
- embeddings drift for compare API (small but noisy)

Ben: Add one more: memory leak on dedicated nodes causing occasional restarts in staging. I have a repro.

Sarah: FWIW FinCorp flagged the truncation as a showstopper — they're on Dedicated and saw it in prod yesterday.

Carol: My initial take: ship 2–3 small fixes in a 3-day hotpatch (canary + ramp). Move lower-priority items and enhancements into next sprint with clear acceptance criteria. Rollout: canary -> 10% -> 100% with automatic rollback on error rate > 3x baseline. :thumbsup:

Alex: Proposal for decision rules:
- Hotfix if severity >= P1 OR >5 paying customers impacted within 24h
- Everything else -> enhancement backlog for next sprint or targeted follow-on milestone

Proposed hotfix candidates: latency spike, truncated responses, memory leak.
Enhancement bucket: embeddings quality fix, small UX polish, docs/telemetry improvements.

Maya: +1. Also recommend quick safety net: only fixes that don't touch model weights or require retraining (no model swaps). And prefer <200 LOC changes. Test matrix must include unit + integration + a short e2e chat replay.

Ben: I'll own the latency fix. Reproducer (short):
```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-1","prompt":"repeat long input...","stream":true}'
```
Looks like batching window misbehavior under high concurrency — will instrument and try a batching-window tweak.

Sarah: I'll own comms and customer outreach. Drafted a message for FinCorp explaining our rollback/mitigation path and ETA. Will post once we confirm timeline.

deploy-bot: CI started: build-332 for branch/hotfix/2002 (lint -> unit -> integration).

Alex: Prioritization rubric (proposal):
```
P0: outage / data loss / security (immediate stop-the-line)
P1: customer-facing regression affecting >1 customer OR dedicated node restarts
P2: quality regressions, performance degrade under 2x, single-customer impact
P3: UX, docs, small enhancements
```
If we agree, we triage today and pick the 3 items for hotfix.

Carol: Timeline suggestion: triage today (async), dev tomorrow, canary Wed morning, full ramp Fri EOD if no regressions. Will prepare rollout playbook and metrics dashboard (latency p50/p95, error rate, OOM counts).

Alex: Action items condensed: Ben -> latency instrument + PR, Maya -> test plan + acceptance matrices, Sarah -> comms + FinCorp sync, Carol -> rollout playbook + dashboard, Alex -> create GH issues and assign.

Maya: Created GitHub issues: #8132 (latency-streaming), #8133 (chat-truncation), #8134 (dedicated-memory-leak). Links: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/issues/8132 etc.

Ben: Pushing branch now: branch/hotfix/2002 (small change to batching logic).

deploy-bot: CI passed for build-332 — artifacts ready.

Carol: Starting canary rollout now (10 hosts, 2% traffic). Monitoring dashboards pinned in #eng-sre.

Sarah: Sent initial note to FinCorp (status + expected canary + ETA).

Alex: Thanks all. We'll sync if canary shows regressions. If green, we ramp to 10% -> 100% per the playbook.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout reached 10% at 2002345695 (no regressions detected so far).
